assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official overall design boundary and the three key-area polygons are not yet published; all area ratios, phasing and node attribution must be recomputed when official geometry is supplied.
assumptions.impact: Current geometry is provisional for display and content discussion only; not a basis for precise area or professional scoring.

assumptions.statement: Specialized evidence (per-asset rights, detailed accessibility audit, regional coordination data, site-specific engineering conditions) is not yet fully verifiable in this package.
assumptions.impact: Items lacking evidence are marked partial/data_gap in the matrices rather than claimed complete; they must be completed with credible sources or professional input.

assumptions.statement: A3/A0 PDF rendering currently has font/garbled-text and layout issues; spatial figures are simplified.
assumptions.impact: Professional drawing review cannot rely on current PDFs/figures; regeneration with embedded licensed Chinese fonts and a proper drawing pipeline is a required next step.
